clean.tx: E ko kore te ura era mā nīrā.
clean.tl: The lobster won’t be lacking (=we will have plenty of lobster) for today.

clean.tx: He ui, ku kore ā te taŋi.
clean.tl: He looked (at his wife); the crying was over.

clean.tx: Te ŋā poki matua kore era o koā Eugenio te hāpao.
clean.tl: Children without parents, Eugenio and the others took care of them.
